calls.title: Two forestry courses still sit on AGRI under a parent on ENVR
calls.text: Open Asks Sheet 105 card 1: AGRI M10SY Forest Surveying and AGRI M1104 Introduction to Forest Operations are merged into Forest Ecology, which moved to ENVR on Sheet 104. The dry run that moves both to ENVR is committed; the session's permission check held its apply.

calls.title: Six curated anchor entries the re-key dry run cannot settle
calls.text: Three collide with other courses on their new Common SUBJ and need fresh numbers; three hospitality entries have no MQ discipline. On no reply they stay unapplied.
